services.name: College Prep Camp
services.desc: This program is designed for rising seniors in the Class of 2027 who want a strong start on the college application process. Students will get clear direction on college search, personal statements, and supplemental essays, along with individualized feedback from our experienced counselors and admissions professionals. They’ll leave camp with real progress made and their biggest questions answered. And because it is the Lair, we’re building in plenty of downtime too. Students can swim, hang out with new friends, play games, and enjoy the mountains while balancing work with fun. services.name: Year-Round Cabins
services.desc: Camp Oski is your perfect home base for a winter or spring getaway in the mountains. Spend your days hiking, hitting the slopes, playing in the snow, or simply relaxing fireside in the Lair Lodge or around your firepit. Then return to one of our 15 cozy, winterized cabins for a comfortable night’s rest. Enjoy delicious included meals in the Oski Dining Hall, plus all the magic of the Lair. Cabins sleep up to six, making Camp Oski an easy and memorable getaway for families and friends. It’s camping, but with a serious (and warmer) upgrade!
